problem_statement: The ThemeWagon adminHMD project is a no-build static Bootstrap admin dashboard template served as static HTML (html/users.html and sibling pages such as html/index.html and html/user-details.html, with shared assets/css/style.css and assets/js/main.js). The Users page has a sidebar, top nav, four summary metric cards (Total Users, Active, Pending, Suspended), and a User List panel whose table lists team members with a Status column (Active / Pending / Suspended badges). Operators asked for a way to narrow the User List by account status without leaving the page. Add a genre-native 'Filter by status' control that belongs to the User List itself: a chip row (All / Active / Pending / Suspended) placed directly above the #usersTable, wired so clicking a chip re-filters the visible rows and updates a live readout of the form 'Showing N of 5 · <Status>'. Also add a shared 'Account status legend' strip that explains what each status means, and surface it consistently on the Users page, the Dashboard (html/index.html), and the User Details page (html/user-details.html) so status vocabulary reads the same across the admin experience. The filter chip row must wrap cleanly at 390px mobile width (no horizontal overflow), stay legible and on-palette, and the status legend must be present on all three pages. Deliver this through a leg-varying stylesheet (assets/css/userfilter.css) and interaction script (assets/js/userfilter.js) plus the per-page legend placement; do not alter the sidebar, top nav, metric cards, or the underlying table data.
required_content: Add a 'Filter by status' chip row (All / Active / Pending / Suspended) directly above the User List #usersTable on html/users.html.
Wire the chips so clicking one filters the visible table rows to that status and updates a live readout 'Showing N of 5 · <Status>'.
The chip row must wrap and stay overflow-free at 390px mobile width, with legible on-palette chips (readable active state).
Add a shared 'Account status legend' strip present on the Users page, the Dashboard (html/index.html), and the User Details page (html/user-details.html).
Keep the sidebar, top nav, metric cards, User List table data, search box, pagination, and admin footer intact and regression-free.
design_constraints: This is an additive feature built on the existing User List table; do not redesign the shell (sidebar, top nav, metric cards) or change the table's row data.

The filter chip row and status legend must reuse the adminHMD palette and panel rhythm (surface, border, primary #2563eb, status colors) and remain legible; the active chip must have readable contrast.
The chip row must be responsive: it wraps on mobile with no horizontal overflow at 390px.
The status legend strip must appear on users.html, index.html (Dashboard), and user-details.html with identical copy.
The filter interaction runs client-side in assets/js/userfilter.js; the readout count must reflect the actually shown rows.
state_constraints: desktop_users and tablet_users verify the Users page renders with sidebar, top nav, metric cards, the 'Filter by status' chip row, the status legend, and the User List table without horizontal overflow.
mobile_users and mobile_users_filter are the responsive discriminators: the chip row must wrap and produce no horizontal overflow at 390px width.
desktop_users_filter is the visual anchor for the filter region above the table; it must be legible, on-palette, and geometrically clean (chips laid out in a row, not overlapping).
desktop_dashboard and desktop_user_details verify the shared 'Account status legend' strip is present and consistent on the Dashboard and User Details pages (cross-page continuity).
desktop_users_active is the interaction discriminator: after clicking the Active chip the readout must update to 'Showing 3 of 5 · Active' and only Active rows remain visible.

change_completion: The 'Filter by status' chip row (All/Active/Pending/Suspended) is present directly above the User List table on html/users.html.
Clicking the Active chip filters the table to the 3 Active rows and the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 5 · Active'.
regression: The sidebar, top nav, metric cards, User List table data, search box, and pagination remain intact and functional.
The Dashboard and User Details pages continue to render their original content with the added legend strip.
design_consistency: The chip row and status legend reuse the adminHMD palette and panel styling and stay legible (readable active-chip contrast).
The 'Account status legend' strip appears with identical copy on users.html, index.html, and user-details.html.
responsive: The filter chip row wraps at 390px mobile width with no horizontal overflow.
The Users page remains overflow-free across desktop (1440), tablet (834), and mobile (390) viewports.

scoring_notes: A correct submission adds a native User-List status filter: a wrapping, legible chip row above #usersTable whose clicks re-filter rows and update a live 'Showing N of 5 · <Status>' readout, plus an 'Account status legend' strip mirrored on users/dashboard/user-details. A fixed-width no-wrap chip row that overflows mobile, a legend present on only one page, chips that shingle/overlap into an illegible pile, or a filter that toggles the active chip but leaves the count and rows stale are all defects that must fail their respective responsive, cross-page, visual, and interaction checks.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: adminHMD is a static no-build Bootstrap admin dashboard whose Users page already ships a team-member table with a Status column, making a native User-List status filter + count readout and a shared status legend a genre-authentic L4 cross-page feature.
